summary: Verified all three IFPI Learning Platform fixes via browser automation as the learner (learner@ifpi.org). FIX 1 (cert history clean), FIX 2 (silent /auth/me probe), and FIX 3 (exam gate + already-passed shortcut) all PASS.

FIX_1_cert_history.evidence: GET /certificates lists 4 real certs (IFPI Fundamentals, Client Onboarding & Consultation, Gym Health & Safety Essentials, Foundations of Exercise Science). No 'TEST_iter27', 'TEST_iter28' or 'TEST_iter' debris strings on the page. Download PDF / Copy link / Add to LinkedIn / Verify buttons render for each.

FIX_2_silent_auth_probe.evidence: Anonymous session (cookies + localStorage cleared): /api/auth/me requests fired on / = 0; on /catalog = 0. Zero 401 console errors. After login as learner: localStorage 'ifpi_session_hint' = '1' set; page reload triggered /auth/me (2 calls, session restored, user stays logged in). After logout + storage clear + reload of /, no anonymous /auth/me requests fired and no 401 console noise (0 console 401 errors overall across the run).

FIX_3_exam_gate_main.evidence: /learn/221 last-slide button label = 'Take exam' (via data-testid=next-slide-btn). Clicking navigated to /take/4. start-exam-btn started attempt. Answered Q1 option-2 (ATP-PC phosphagen), Q2 option-1 (Gradually increasing training demand), Q3 option-1 (During recovery between sessions), Q4 option-2 (Volume), Q5 tf-true. Submitted → result page shows 'Congratulations! You passed.' with 100% score, +150 XP, toast 'Course complete! Certificate issued.', and exam-view-certificate-btn visible. Clicking View Certificate navigated to /certificates where 'Foundations of Exercise Science' completion certificate is now listed.

FIX_3b_already_passed_shortcut.evidence: /learn/1 (IFPI Fundamentals — exam already passed) last-slide button label = 'Complete' (not 'Take exam'), confirming exam_passed=true short-circuits the gate.

FIX_3c_failure_path.evidence: Not exercised to preserve remaining exam attempts (max_attempts=3), per reviewer's guidance.

seed_data_creation: None. Did not touch DB. New real certificate for course 221 was issued organically through the exam-pass flow.
